question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

There is no __transparency__ in the procedure followed by the company.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Opacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"transparency"** means the quality of being easily seen through or detected; openness, and clarity in communication or procedures. (पारदर्शिता)

 
 
• **Example: **The transparency of the glass allowed us to see the beautiful garden outside.
 
 
 
• **"Opacity" **refers to the quality of being obscure, not transparent, or hard to see through; lack of clarity or transparency. (अस्पष्टता)
 
 
• **Example: **The opacity of the frosted glass ensured privacy in the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'transparency' **is **'opacity'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Opacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reliability** (विश्वसनीयता): The quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well.

 
 
• **Example:** The reliability of the new software ensured that the system rarely crashed.
 
 
 
• **Coherence** (सामंजस्य): The quality of being logical and consistent.
 
 
• **Example:** The coherence of his argument made it very convincing.
 
 
 
• **Clarity** (स्पष्टता): The quality of being clear and easy to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand the complex topic.
